title: Special Fried Rice
subtitle: A peppery takeout style special fried rice
intro: This recipe is by Jason Farmer, where he tasted fried rice from 30+ different takeaways and then distilled them into the following recipe for home use.
steps: Heat wok or pan over medium high heat until lightly smoking, add 1 tbsp Neutral oil, turn heat to low and add Eggs, scramble and remove from pan setting aside for later and wipe down the pan.
Return pan to medium heat, add 1 tbsp Neutral oil, add Chicken and cook until 90% done about 2-3 minutes, remove Chicken from pan and set aside and wipe down the pan.
Return pan to medium heat, add 1 tbsp Neutral oil, add Onion and Carrot and cook until Onion is transparent about 1-2 minutes, add Garlic and for cook 1 minute .
Add Rice to the cooked vegetables breaking up any clumps and cook for 2-4 minutes, add the Chicken & Eggs and mix together well.
Push the rice to the center of the pan and add the sauce around the rim of the pan, stir until rice and sauce are fully incorporated, add the seasoning mix and stir into the rice.
Add the Scallions and Bean sprouts, mix together, then push the rice to the center again and add the Shaoxing wine to the rim of the pan, stir together.
Turn off the heat, add the Toasted sesame oil, mix together.
Adjust seasoning with Salt and White pepper, Plate, top with Sesame seeds.
Serve.
note: Save some Scallion for a garnish along with the Sesame seeds

title: Alfredo Pasta Bake
subtitle: A creamy, garlic, and cheesy pasta bake
intro: A mouthwatering creamy garlic alfredo pasta bake, topped with crispy melted cheese by Tasty.
steps: In a pot, heat oil and add chicken. Season chicken with salt and pepper, add garlic, then brown the chicken. Add broth, heavy cream, and pasta, and bring to a boil. Cover and reduce the heat to a simmer for 15-20 min.

Turn off heat and stir in 1 ½ cups of parmesan cheese. Pour half of the pasta into a greased 11x7 inch or 9x13 inch baking dish. Sprinkle evenly with 1 cup of mozzarella cheese. Layer the remaining half of the pasta evenly on top. Sprinkle evenly with 1 cup of mozzarella and ½ cup of parmesan.
Broil 10 - 15 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown. Remove and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve.
note: Rest for at least 10 minutes to let the pasta and sauce set.

title: Chilli
subtitle: A satisfying, hearty beef and bean Chili recipe
intro: Preppy Kitchens Mouthwatering beef and bean chilli

ingredients.item: Red kidney beans - rinsed and drained

steps: Heat the Oil in a large dutch oven over medium high heat, add the Onion and Bell pepper and cook, stirring frequently, until slightly softened, about 5 minutes, add the Garlic and cook for 1 more minute.
Add the Mince beef and cook for about 5 minutes, breaking into small pieces with a wooden spoon until no longer pink.

Reduce the heat to medium, add the Tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, add the Chilli powder, Cumin, Oregano, Salt, Cayenne, and Black Pepper, cook for 1 minute stirring frequently, until the spices are aromatic, add the Cocoa powder and Brown suger, mix for 1 minute.
Stir in the Diced tomatoes, Tomato passata, Kidney beans, Pinto beans, and Beef stock, scraping the bottom of the dutch oven to loosen any browned bits and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium low, and simmer uncovered for 30-45 minutes until the chilli thickens, season with more Salt and Black pepper to taste.
Plate and top with Grated cheese, Sour cream, Scallions, and Doritos.
Serve
note: can be nice with chips instead of rice, go easy on the Grated cheese as it can mute the flavour of the chilli, and the Doritos are pretty much a must with this dish

title: Spiced Lamb Shoulder
subtitle: Slow-roasted with cumin, coriander, and preserved lemon
intro: Lamb shoulder is unforgiving only if you rush it. Given time and low heat, the collagen dissolves, the fat renders, and you are left with meat that falls apart at the press of a spoon.

ingredients.item: preserved lemon quarters, skin finely chopped

steps: Make the spice paste: combine all spices, preserved lemon, garlic, and olive oil. Season generously.
Score the lamb deeply all over. Massage the paste into every surface and into the cuts. Refrigerate overnight if possible.
Bring lamb to room temperature 1 hour before cooking. Preheat oven to 220 °C. Place in a deep tray, pour in stock, roast uncovered 20 minutes.
Cover tightly with double foil, reduce to 160 °C, and roast 3–3.5 hours until a skewer meets no resistance near the bone.
Remove foil, raise to 200 °C, roast 15 minutes more to lacquer. Rest 30 minutes, then pull apart with forks.
note: The braising juices are extraordinary — skim off excess fat and serve them alongside as a sauce.
